description: Fetch web pages through Zenscrape proxies with optional browser rendering.

auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Zenscrape API key passed as the apikey query parameter. Register or view your key in the Zenscrape app: https://app.zenscrape.com/register

actions.name: fetch_url
actions.description: Fetch one public URL through Zenscrape with optional rendering, proxy, header, and wait controls.

url.description: The public target URL Zenscrape should request.

render.description: Whether Zenscrape should render JavaScript before returning the page.

premium.description: Whether Zenscrape should use premium proxies for the request.

location.description: The Zenscrape proxy location code, such as na, eu, or a premium country code.

deviceType.description: The device type Zenscrape should emulate.

waitFor.description: How long Zenscrape should wait before returning the page response.

waitForCss.description: The CSS selector Zenscrape should wait for before returning the page response.

blockAds.description: Whether Zenscrape should block ads while loading the page.

javascriptSnippet.description: The JavaScript snippet Zenscrape should execute before returning the page response.

items.description: A resource type Zenscrape should block while loading the page.

blockResources.description: The resource types Zenscrape should block while loading the page.

keepHeaders.description: Whether Zenscrape should forward provided custom headers to the target URL.

customHeaders.description: Custom HTTP headers Zenscrape should forward to the target URL when keepHeaders is true.

cookies.description: The Cookie header value Zenscrape should forward to the target URL.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for fetching one URL with Zenscrape.

body.description: The response body returned by Zenscrape.

statusCode.description: The HTTP status code returned by Zenscrape.

anyOf.description: The response content type returned by Zenscrape.

contentType.description: The response content type returned by Zenscrape.

metadata.description: Metadata collected from the Zenscrape response.

headers.description: Response headers returned by Zenscrape or the target website.

outputSchema.description: The response returned when fetching a URL with Zenscrape.
